show.description: “Dark Secrets” is an intense romantic thriller that follows Ananya, a young doctor trapped in a web of deceit, betrayal, and hidden agendas after being falsely accused of a scandal. When her path crosses with Kabir Deewan, a man awakening from a coma with a mysterious past, their fates intertwine in a dangerous game of love, revenge, and shocking family secrets
